name: ER Stress Response and UPR (Expanded)
description: The Unfolded Protein Response (UPR) in S. cerevisiae responds to ER stress caused by accumulation of misfolded proteins. The sensor Ire1 is an ER transmembrane kinase-endoribonuclease that oligomerizes upon binding unfolded proteins in the ER lumen. Activated Ire1 splices HAC1 mRNA, removing an intron to produce functional Hac1 transcription factor. Hac1 enters the nucleus and activates UPR target genes encoding ER chaperones (Kar2/BiP, Pdi1), ERAD components (Der1, Hrd1), and lipid biosynthesis enzymes to expand ER capacity. The pathway has high AND gate requirements for Ire1 activation (oligomerization) and mRNA splicing (exon ligation).
scientificAccuracy: Based on extensive research on yeast UPR, paradigm for ER stress responses. All components validated.
